title: Moonlight 28 · A Sword of My Own
description: Powerful players offer Weed everything he needs. He refuses—and learns what four weeks of stubborn practice have really earned him.
sources: Personal Mandarin adaptation of The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Chapter 4: high-level recruitment, refusal, completed training and Hard Iron Sword. Stops before the question about other graduates. Dialogue branches are authored; canonical events and rewards are preserved.

planning.voiceReason: Explicit user choice; competing recruitment and training intentions, followed by an earned relationship turn.
planning.sourceBoundary: Pinned Chapter 4 recruitment through basic-training sword, before A question suddenly occurred to Weed.
planning.promise: Weed wants to finish the strength he has worked for; recruiters offer funded advancement, testing whether he will abandon his solitary method.
planning.earlyCare: Four weeks of costly repetitive effort visible through the worn practice sword.
planning.dramaticChange: Recruiters recognize his value; his refusal commits him to finish. The instructor openly revises his initial low opinion, and Weed accepts praise with calculated flattery.
planning.localPayoff: Training maximized, exact five stat rewards, instructor respect and Hard Iron Sword.
planning.continuingQuestion: The word basic recasts four weeks of effort as only a beginning; no later graduate-count question is asked yet.

planning.conversation: Recruiter wants a useful future ally; Weed insists on finishing his own work. Instructor wants achievement recognized as good teaching; Weed wants goodwill and knows how to flatter. Solo kingdom context is compressed to three beats.

characterSignatures.Hyun: Brief practical refusals; tired private relief; formal public flattery conceals calculation. Restrained expression and persistent training.
characterSignatures.Watcher: Anonymous high-level recruiter representative, generous promises and strategic follow-up; quiet surprise at rejection.
characterSignatures.Instructor: Proud direct evaluation, willing admission of error, hearty self-satisfaction when praised.

planning.directing: Pair through recruiter exchange. Action framing for training, stop at stat sound. Pair with instructor; camera listener Hyun on admission of error, Continue-controlled private aftermath, pair for both gratitude branches and sword.

sceneActivities.purpose: Resumed work realizes refusal, interrupted permanently by final stat reward.

teaser.adaptation: Authored English condensation of fixed refusal and training commitment.

notice: This episode adapts The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor into a Mandarin adventure. Some dialogue and choices have been added while preserving the novel’s events.

verification.vocabularyPolicy: 804 reviewed-known plus 196 distinct authorized assumed-familiar words; no expansion.
limitations: Sword exchange is narrated, not an animated handoff. The existing practice sword prop is metal-colored; the text identifies it as wood.
verification.listenerReview: Twelve listener, aftermath and rejoined-response beats played with audio across two routes on phone and desktop, including reduced motion. Screenshots inspected; each aftermath remains until Continue. Automated playback and speech recognition do not establish subjective listening quality.

settings.prompt: Animate this exact reference for six seconds. Weed alone says exactly once in clear English: "I'll earn my own strength." Start at second 0.5, finish by 4.5, then mouth closed. No extra words, repetitions, paraphrases, fillers, humming, narration, singing or other voices. Quiet training-hall room tone beneath clearly audible dialogue. One subtle slow push in. His grip on the wooden practice sword firms slightly; keep sword safely down. Tired but unyielding, eyes steady toward the unseen recruiter. Preserve face, clothes and anatomy. No added people, text, magic or battle.

teaser.offlineFinish: Preserved native source privately. Muted soundtrack before 3.5 seconds, before the verified intended phrase beginning at 3.8 seconds, to remove unwanted leading speech. Full six-second motion retained, three-second first-frame hold prepended. No paid retry.
